# Traitor Job Board
[italic] "You want to make a name for yourself? Well, you can start by planting this bug in the CMO's office for me..." [/italic]
Your [color=#ff0000]employers[/color] have provided you with a job board app hidden inside your uplink.
Each job listing is a mini-objective you can complete for a small reward, like extra telecrystals or sometimes even an uplink item.
The more side jobs you do, the more your reputation within the syndicate will grow, and the tougher and more rewarding your work will be.
Do you think you have what it takes to go down in history as a [color=#ff0000]Living Legend[/color]?
## The Basics The syndicate is kind enough to provide you up to [bold]four[/bold] side jobs at a time.
You can have up to [bold]two[/bold] side jobs currently accepted.
Some jobs give you special [bold]tools[/bold] which materialise in your hands when you [bold]accept[/bold].
The accepted side jobs have a progress bar, and when complete, you can [bold]claim[/bold] your reward.
You get a certain amount of [bold]reputation[/bold] and either a bit of [bold][color=#ff0000]TC[/color][/bold] or (rarely) an [bold][color=#ff0000]uplink item[/color][/bold].
You can [bold]cancel[/bold] an accepted sidejob at any time and it will disappear.
When you [bold]cancel[/bold] or [bold]claim[/bold] you are left with a gaping hole in your job board which can only be filled by clicking the [bold]refresh[/bold] button.
When you click the [bold]refresh[/bold] button all side jobs which are not accepted disappear, and then new side jobs are generated to fill you back up to [bold]four[/bold] concurrent side jobs.
You can't just refresh whenever you want - this isn't a charity! The button unlocks after [bold]10 minutes[/bold] of no refreshing or when you earn a new [bold]title[/bold].
## Titles You start life with 0 reputation.
At 0-99 reputation you have the title 'Goody Two-Shoes Nobody'.
At 100-499 reputation you have the title 'Up-and-Coming Crook'.
At 500-999 reputation you have the title 'Front Page News'.
At 1000-9999 reputation you have the title 'Terrifying Presence'.
At 10000+ reputation you have the title 'Living Legend'.
The final title is a giant leap from the one before it. To get that much reputation, you have to do something [bold][color=#ff0000]really important[/color][/bold].
## Side Jobs ### Bug an Office
[bold]Available to:[/bold] 'Goody Two-Shoes Nobody' and above
[bold]Reward:[/bold] 100 reputation + 7 TC [bold]OR[/bold] 10 TC value uplink item
Ever heard the phrase 'The Customer is always right?'
Someone is paying us to install this spying device in someone's office. But it's a little... conspicuous.
Luckily, our end of the contract only concerns installation, not long term support. So wrench the bug inside their office then get out of there before anyone sees it!
Don't try to con us by having someone else wrench the bug for you. [bold]You need to wrench the bug[/bold] otherwise it won't count.
### Steal a Gizmo
[bold]Available to:[/bold] 'Up-and-Coming Crook' and above
[bold]Reward:[/bold] 200 reputation + 10 TC [bold]OR[/bold] 15 TC value uplink item
The station is full to the brim with experimental tech. I know a few people who are willing to pay top dollar for a glance at the schematics.
We are sending you on a coporate espionage mission. When you accept this side job a scanalyzer will materialse into your hands.
Steal the gizmo and then once you are in a secluded place, use the scanalyzer to scan it.
Don't try to con us by having someone else scan the gizmo for you. [bold]You need to scan the item[/bold] otherwise it won't count.
We don't care what happens to the gizmo afterwards. Throw it down the trash for all we care. It would be wise to ditch the scanalyzer afterwards too.
Just make sure to wear gloves so you don't get your fingerprints everywhere. We won't bail you out of jail if you get caught.
### Take a Life
[bold]Available to:[/bold] 'Up-and-Coming Crook' and above
[bold]Reward:[/bold] 200 reputation + 10 TC [bold]OR[/bold] 15 TC value uplink item
You don't get to work on a prestigious research station without making a few enemies in the process.
Pratically everyone onboard has a price on their head, and for this side job we want you to kill one specific person.
All that matters is they are dead, then you can claim your reward. You can kill them or they can die of natural causes or whatever, we don't care. If through the miracle of medicine they come back to life [bold]after[/bold] you claimed your reward, we don't care either.
They have to be actually dead, not in a critical state.
Just don't try anything weird like killing a bunch of people for free. No one is going to pay you to kill someone who is already dead.
### Kill your Boss
[bold]Available to:[/bold] 'Front Page News' and above
[bold]Reward:[/bold] 500 reputation + 15 TC [bold]OR[/bold] 20 TC value uplink item
No one likes their boss. Some people even want them dead!
You are being paid to kill a 'head of staff'. Their lives are more important so killing them is going to be more difficult.
You have all the same rules from the previous side job.
### Obliterate the Station
[bold]Available to:[/bold] 'Terrifying Presence'
[bold]Reward:[/bold] 10,000 reputation + syndicate lifetime achievement award
Right now everyone is scared of Nanotrasen.
But if you can do a bunch of side jobs and prove their security is incredibly lax, I'm sure you can call up some scary ex-military mercenaries to the station.
They'll probably bring a nuclear bomb with them and blow everything to kingdom come.
Just use the provided syndicate broadcast device on a comms computer.
Don't think you can bumrush the bridge at minute 0 and end the shift instantly. You got to be a real mean syndicate to even unlock this side job in the first place.
And if they catch you they are probably going to kill you.
